eyebrow: About RN Collins and Aloha AI
title: I work on questions too messy for a single discipline.
summary: RN Collins works across law, neuroscience, developmental psychology, research, education, AI systems, emerging industries, and product development to make the hidden structure of complex work explicit and usable.
audience: Institutions, experts, funders, legal professionals, educators, and builders considering RN Collins or Aloha AI for interdisciplinary research, systems, education, product, or partnership work.

institutionalSections.title: From how people understand the world to how institutions operationalize it.
institutionalSections.intro: Psychology, neuroscience, research operations, law, and AI each contribute a different part of the method. Aloha AI is the commercial and product expression of that body of work.

items.title: Psychology and development
items.subtitle: People are not interchangeable users.
items.text: Development, learning, identity, family, culture, motivation, and context shape whether a system is understandable, trustworthy, and usable.

items.title: Research and regulatory operations
items.subtitle: Rigor is operational.

items.title: Law and legal engineering
items.subtitle: Authority, exceptions, and accountability cannot be hidden.
items.text: Legal work sharpens the distinction between retrieval, interpretation, judgment, advice, approval, and the consequences of getting them wrong.

items.title: AI systems and product development
items.subtitle: The interface is only the surface.
items.text: Durable value lies in the knowledge model, rules, workflows, evidence, human review, governance, maintenance, and commercial structure underneath.

title: The honest, short version.
summary: Aloha AI sets no cookies, builds no advertising profile, uses cookieless aggregate analytics and speed measurement, runs interactive tools entirely in the browser, and holds only the information a visitor voluntarily sends by booking or email.
audience: Visitors, prospective clients, partners, learners, and tool users who need to understand what Aloha AI collects, how it is used, and how to request access or deletion.
policyOwner: Aloha AI, a DBA of Rayven-Nikkita Collins LLC · Honolulu, HI

policySections.title: Cookieless analytics, no ad tracking, no profile of you
paragraphs: The homepage loads Vercel Web Analytics and Speed Insights. These are cookieless: they record aggregate, non-identifying signals such as page views, referrer, country-level location, and load performance, so Aloha AI can see what is useful and whether pages are fast. They set no cookies, do not fingerprint you across other sites, and do not build an advertising profile. No advertising or third-party ad trackers run anywhere on the site.

policySections.title: The tools run in your browser
paragraphs: Interactive tools, monitors, and figures compute entirely on your device. Information entered into a tool stays in the browser and is not transmitted to Aloha AI, a server, or a third party. Close the tab and it is gone.

policySections.title: What is collected
paragraphs: The only personal information Aloha AI holds is what you voluntarily provide when you get in touch. No account is required to use the public site.
points: If you book a call: the details entered in the booking form, typically name, email address, and any note, handled through Microsoft Outlook Bookings.
If you email: your email address, your name if included, and the contents of the message.

policySections.title: How it is used
paragraphs: Information you send is used to respond to you and, if an engagement begins, to run that engagement. It is not added to a marketing list or used to contact you about something you did not request.

policySections.title: Storage and third parties
paragraphs: Bookings are processed by Microsoft Outlook Bookings under Microsoft’s terms and privacy practices. Email is handled by ordinary mail providers. These providers supply the message infrastructure; Aloha AI does not share information beyond what is needed to receive and reply.

policySections.title: No sale of data
paragraphs: Aloha AI does not sell, rent, or trade personal information.

policySections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You may ask what information Aloha AI holds about you and request deletion. Because the retained information is limited to what you sent, either request can be made directly by email.

policySections.title: Children
paragraphs: The site is intended for professionals and is not directed to children under 13. Aloha AI does not knowingly collect information from children. If you believe a child has sent information, request deletion by email.

policySections.title: Changes
paragraphs: If this policy changes, the effective date will change with it. Material changes are unlikely under the collect-almost-nothing approach.

policySections.title: Governing law
paragraphs: This policy is governed by the laws of the State of Hawaii.

evidence: The site’s configured analytics and interactive-tool behavior
The Microsoft Outlook Bookings and ordinary email collection paths
Documented absence of advertising trackers, public-site accounts, and server-submitted tool inputs
methodology: Minimize collection by default
Keep public interactive processing in the browser
Use cookieless aggregate analytics only
Limit retained personal information to voluntary contact and engagement records
Honor access and deletion requests directly
assumptions: Deployed analytics and tool behavior remain consistent with this published policy
Third-party providers process information under their applicable terms and privacy practices
limitations: This policy describes Aloha AI’s public site and direct contact paths, not every independently governed client system or third-party website

title: Simple, fair, and clear.
summary: Terms governing use of the informational Aloha AI website and its illustrative tools, including verification requirements, professional-boundary disclaimers, separate engagement agreements, warranties, liability, intellectual property, governing law, and changes.
audience: Visitors, prospective clients, partners, learners, and tool users who need the governing terms for the Aloha AI public website.
policyOwner: Aloha AI, a DBA of Rayven-Nikkita Collins LLC · Honolulu, HI

policySections.title: The site is informational
paragraphs: This website describes a practice and shows examples of its work. Nothing on it is an offer of a specific outcome, and using the site does not create any professional or contractual relationship. It is here to inform, not to instruct.

policySections.title: Tools and figures are illustrative: verify before you rely
paragraphs: Interactive tools, monitors, scores, and figures are illustrative models. They are built to help you think through a question, not to serve as the final word. Before making a decision, filing anything, or otherwise relying on an output, verify it against primary sources: the statute, docket, filing, or peer-reviewed record. Aloha AI is not responsible for decisions made on unverified illustrative output.

policySections.title: Not legal or tax advice (UPL disclaimer)
paragraphs: RN Collins is a JD candidate, not a licensed attorney. Aloha AI provides regulatory intelligence and AI systems, not legal or tax advice. Nothing on this site or in any engagement creates an attorney–client relationship, and nothing here should be treated as a substitute for advice from a licensed attorney or tax professional in your jurisdiction. The work is built to support the licensed professionals who give that advice, not to replace them.

policySections.title: Engagements are governed by separate agreements
paragraphs: Any paid work, whether audits, builds, retainers, or fractional leadership, is governed by a separate written agreement signed by both parties. Where that agreement and these terms differ, the signed agreement controls for that engagement. These terms govern only use of this website.

policySections.title: No warranties
paragraphs: The site and its illustrative tools are provided “as is,” without warranties of any kind, express or implied, including accuracy, completeness, fitness for a particular purpose, or non-infringement. Regulatory and scientific facts change; outputs may be incomplete or out of date when read.

policySections.title: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Aloha AI and Rayven-Nikkita Collins LLC will not be liable for indirect, incidental, consequential, or special damages arising from use of this site or its illustrative tools. Paid engagements carry their own liability terms in their signed agreements.

policySections.title: Intellectual property
paragraphs: All site content, including text, tools, figures, design, and code, is © Rayven-Nikkita Collins LLC unless otherwise noted. You may read and reference it; you may not copy, republish, or build derivative products from it without permission.

policySections.title: Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Hawaii, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.

policySections.title: Changes
